assets.prompt: A minimal hand-drawn notebook UI icon. One dark moss-green ink monoline (#293c32), rounded strokes, controlled slight organic irregularity, unfilled outlines. SIMPLE SVG-LIKE CLARITY, not a painting. Wide bold strokes about 46 pixels thick on the 1024 canvas, so it reads at 24 pixels. Subject centred within central 820x820 with generous even padding. Absolutely flat bright magenta (#ff00ff) background for chroma key removal, identical solid colour inside and outside all outlines. No white fill, no paper, shading, shadow, wash, grain, gradients, badge, lettering, decorative speckles, or extra objects. Exactly ONE side-profile freshwater fish facing left: one simple continuous body outline, forked tail, an eye dot, a short curved gill, one small dorsal fin, one lower fin. Few confident lines. Friendly recognisable fish silhouette. No scales, no water. Fish fills the width, roughly twice as wide as tall.
